predecessors.name: Sajid dynasty
predecessors.text: Tabriz, where the Rawadids ruled as local lords of Azdi Arab ancestry under the Sajids (page: dynasty dates 900-1071)

successors.name: Great Seljuk Empire
successors.text: Azerbaijan: "The Seljuks under Tughril conquered the principality in 1054 CE"

ledger.x: 948: the Rawadids take land northeast of Tabriz.
1054: the independent Rawadid principality ends with the Seljuk conquest.

wars.name: Rawadid conquest of Sallarid Azerbaijan
wars.outcome: Land northeast of Tabriz in 948, most of Azerbaijan around 979, the last Sallarid holding in 984.

wars.name: Oghuz crisis in Azerbaijan
wars.outcome: Oghuz families fleeing Mahmud of Ghazni (1028) were settled by Wahsudan as vassals; he helped the Hadhbani Kurds defeat the Oghuz at Maragha in 1029, had Oghuz leaders killed at a dinner in 1040-1041 and was defeated by Turks in the Sarab desert in 1041-1042.

wars.name: Seljuk conquest of the Rawadids
wars.outcome: Tughril conquered the principality in 1054; Wahsudan was defeated and his son Mamlan taken.

certainty.note: A principality known by its cities (Tabriz, Maragha, Ardabil) and the Sahand strongholds; the pages give no frontiers.
